sections.title: SUBMIT A REPORT (report)
sections.text:
CHIRP always protects the identity of our 
reporters. All personal details are deleted 
from our system once a report is completed.

sections.title: ONLINE (report)
sections.text:
Reports can be submitted easily through our 
encrypted online form  
www.chirpmaritime.org/submit-a-report/
